Hi Lena —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the attachments. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

1) Remittance format — yes, the REMIT string you provided is fine. Two small suggestions to make our automated parser more reliable: always include the exact PO token (example: PO:7702) and separate fields with a vertical bar as you did. Example we recommend: 

  ORCHID|PO:7702|INV:2026-1456|CLIENT:REDWOOD

2) Activation process — for new vendors we normally do a micro-deposit verification for ACH unless the bank letter explicitly states account ownership and includes a bank contact line. Your bank certificate helps, but our FinOps team usually also sends two micro-deposits (sent within 24-48 hours) and asks for the amounts back for confirmation. If accounting prefers instant activation, we can escalate to Trusted Vendor workflow (requires procurement approval and a signed indemnity).

3) PO mapping — we will map all invoices that include the PO token to the corresponding PO in our system. If Orchid will ever submit consolidated invoices (one invoice covering multiple POs), please add a 'PO_LIST' field in the remittance line like: PO_LIST:7702,7703.

Next steps:
- I will kick off the onboarding ticket (PO-7742) and upload your forms to our vendor portal.
- Ben will run the micro-deposit unless you confirm you want Trusted Vendor activation.
- Marissa will follow up on PO mapping and send the vendor ID once created.

Once I have the vendor ID I will reply with the exact remittance address to use and the PO prefix Redwood will attach.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Vendor Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
Vendor ops phone: +1 415-555-0122
